makemeahanzi.definition: to give birth, to bring forth, to produce

characterDeckComponents.note: 厂 (chǎng) gives a hint of the sound — 产 is pronounced chǎn, nearly identical apart from the final consonant.
氵 (water) — 浪 names movement on the surface of water, a wave.
良 (liáng) gives a rhyme close to làng, with a different initial and tone.
不 (not) sits above — a negation.
正 (straight, correct) sits below — not straight, giving 歪 its meaning 'askew, crooked.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to stop, to rest, to lodge

characterDeckComponents.note: Yawn — associated with tiredness and needing rest.
Gives the sound hé, related to xiē but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to pant, to gasp, to breathe heavily

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — panting and gasping happen through the mouth.
耑 (duān) gives a sound distantly related to chuǎn, having drifted apart over time.
扌 (hand) — dressing up and costuming traditionally involve the hands.
分 (fēn) gives a sound distantly related to bàn, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: used in 彷彿|仿佛[fang3 fu2]

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 佛 refers to an enlightened being, the Buddha
弗 (fú) gives the sound — an exact match with 佛's reading fú

etymology.hint: A point, small 小 over big 大

characterDeckComponents.note: 小 (small) — a narrow point at the top.
大 (big) — a wider base below, together giving 尖 its meaning 'sharp, pointed.'

meanings: pit or hollow on the human body

makemeahanzi.definition: cave, den, nest; hiding place; measure word for small animals

characterDeckComponents.note: 穴 (cave, hole) — a nest or den is a hollow, cave-like space.
呙 gives a sound close to wō, as it does in the related character 涡 (wō).

makemeahanzi.definition: carriage curtain; sun screen; tent; measure word for buildings

characterDeckComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) — 幢 named a cloth banner or curtain.
童 (tóng) gives a sound distantly related to chuáng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: the sound of a deer bleating

meanings: first of the ten Heavenly Stems 十天干[shi2 tian1 gan1]
(used for an unspecified person or thing)
first (in a list, as a party to a contract etc)

characterDeckComponents.note: 冫 (ice) shows 凉 relates to cold or coolness.
京 (jīng) gives a sound distantly related to liáng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to drag, to tow; to throw; to twist

etymology.hint: To pull 曳 by hand 扌; 曳 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) shows the action is done by hand.

曳 means 'to drag, pull' — its meaning carries directly into 拽. (拽 also has a separate literary reading yè, identical to 曳, though the reading tested here, zhuāi, is the common one meaning 'to throw.')

makemeahanzi.definition: to help, to support; to laud, to praise

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (shell, an ancient form of money) — 赞 originally related to offering valuables in support of someone.
兟 (shēn) gives a sound distantly related to zàn, having drifted apart over time.
饣 (food) — feeling full is a state tied to having eaten enough food.
包 (bāo) gives the sound — a close match for bǎo, differing only in tone.

meanings: the hold of a ship or airplane

etymology.hint: A ship's 舟 cabin 仓; 仓 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: Boat — shows this relates to ships.
Represents a storage space, like a cabin holding cargo.

meanings: used in 脖頸|脖颈[bo2 geng3]

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) — 颈 names a part of the head and neck area.

makemeahanzi.definition: to sink, to plunge; trap, pitfall

etymology.hint: A place 阝 with a pit 臽; 臽 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound, related to terrain) — the ground where something happens.
臽 (a pit) — a hole in the ground, together giving 陷 its meaning 'to sink, to fall into a trap.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to ramble, to stroll, to wander

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walk) — 逛 describes moving around, like strolling.
狂 (kuáng) gives a sound close to guàng, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: cold; to freeze, to congeal; jelly

characterDeckComponents.note: 冫 (ice) — 冻 describes freezing or intense cold.
东 (dōng) gives the sound — an exact match with 冻, differing only in tone.

meanings: dialectal equivalent of 怎麼|怎么[zen3 me5]

makemeahanzi.definition: question-forming particle: why? what? how?; to bite; loud

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 咋 is a spoken question particle.
乍 (zhà) gives a sound distantly related to 咋's reading zǎ, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: to go so far as to

makemeahanzi.definition: finally, after all, at last; indeed; unexpected

etymology.hint: A person 儿 finishing a musical piece 音

characterDeckComponents.note: 音 (music/sound) — a musical piece being performed
儿 (a person) — the performer finishing the piece

makemeahanzi.definition: ancestry, clan, family, lineage; religion, sect

etymology.hint: An altar 示 to the ancestor spirits found in one's home 宀

characterDeckComponents.note: 示 (an altar) — where offerings to ancestors are made
宀 (a roof) — the home where the family altar is kept

meanings: to dry (clothes, grain etc) in the sun
(coll.) to give the cold shoulder to

makemeahanzi.definition: to dry in the sun; to expose to the sun

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) — 晒 describes something exposed to sunlight.
西 (xī) gives a sound distantly related to shài, having drifted apart over time.
木 (tree/wood) — 核 originally named the hard pit inside a fruit.
亥 (hài) gives an approximate sound, close to hé though the vowel has since shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: the sound of someone crying or sobbing

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 呜 is a sound made with the mouth.
乌 (wū) gives the sound — an exact match with 呜.

etymology.hint: Sunlight 日 and children 子 in a building 厂

characterDeckComponents.note: 厂 (a building/shelter) — forms the enclosing shape.
日 (sunlight) — light streaming inside.
子 (children) — together suggesting a household full of light and family, giving 厚 its meaning 'thick, substantial, generous.'

meanings: used in 瑪瑙|玛瑙[ma3 nao3]

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (jade, written as the radical for 玉) — 玛 names a type of precious stone, agate.
马 (mǎ) is an exact match for the sound of 玛.

makemeahanzi.definition: nearby; to adhere to, to attach; to rely on

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound, a place) — 附 relates to being near or attached to a place.
付 (fù) gives the sound — an exact match with 附.

etymology.hint: Like 亦 a bow 弓

characterDeckComponents.note: 弓 (bow) at the bottom is the curved shape being compared to.
The strokes above resemble the shape 亦, suggesting something curved like a bow, giving 弯 its meaning 'bent, curved.'

etymology.hint: Dominating a woman 女 by force of arms 戈

characterDeckComponents.note: 戌 (a halberd/weapon) — represents armed force.
女 (woman) — force used to intimidate gave 威 its meaning 'power, might, awe-inspiring.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to pierce, to prick, to stab; stamp, seal

characterDeckComponents.note: 戈 (a spear/weapon) — 戳 relates to poking or stabbing.
翟 (dí) gives a sound distantly related to 戳's reading chuō, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: rare; to hope for, to strive for; to expect

etymology.hint: A scarf 巾 used to maintain a girl's purity 巾

characterDeckComponents.note: 巾 (cloth) — 帕 names a small piece of woven cloth.
白 (white, plain) — a plain white cloth 巾 gave 帕 its meaning 'kerchief, scarf.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to give; to bestow a favor; to appoint

characterDeckComponents.note: 贝 (money) — bestowing a gift is tied to giving something of value.
易 (yì) gives a sound distantly related to cì, having drifted apart over time.
亻 (person) — 仙 describes a special kind of person, an immortal being.
山 (shān) gives a sound close to xiān.

makemeahanzi.definition: big, large; robust, strong; the name of a tribe

characterDeckComponents.note: 士 (soldier) — 壮 describes someone as strong and robust, like a sturdy soldier.
丬 is only distantly related in sound to zhuàng — the connection has drifted apart to the point of being barely recognizable.
雨 (rain) shows 雾 relates to weather.
务 (wù) gives the exact sound of 雾.
Plant — fragrance often comes from flowers and plants.
Gives the sound fēn, matching the character's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: to expect, to hope, to look forward to

etymology.hint: A king 王 gazing at the moon 月; 亡 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: Depicts a person standing tall, gazing up at the moon 月 — the image of looking into the distance, the source of 望's meaning 'to gaze, hope, expect.'

etymology.hint: An old serving dish 口 on a stand with a lid 一

characterDeckComponents.note: The bowl-shaped body of an old stemmed serving dish.
A lid or rim on top of the dish.
Sun — warmth comes from the sun.
Gives the sound yuán, related to nuǎn but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: drum; to beat, to strike; to rouse

characterDeckComponents.note: 壴 pictures a drum standing on a base.
支 (zhī) gives a sound distantly related to gǔ, having drifted apart over time; it also pictures a hand holding a drumstick.
氵 (water) — 港 names a harbor, a body of water.
巷 (xiàng) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading gǎng has diverged.

etymology.hint: A home 广 with a servant 隶

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 depicts a simple roofed building, a home.
隶 depicts a servant or laborer — a household with help was traditionally a sign of ease and well-being, giving 康 its meaning 'healthy, peaceful.'

meanings: see 謎兒|谜儿[mei4 r5], riddle

etymology.hint: Bewitching 迷 words 讠; 迷 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 谜 is something expressed in words that puzzles the listener.
迷 pictures being lost or bewildered; combined with speech 讠, this gives 谜 its meaning 'a riddle' — words designed to confuse.
